WITH RECURSIVE reach(node_type, node_id, depth, path) AS (
            SELECT CAST(%(start_type)s AS varchar), CAST(%(start_id)s AS uuid), 0,
                   ARRAY[CAST(%(start_key)s AS text)]
          UNION ALL
            SELECT e.target_type, e.target_id, r.depth + 1,
                   r.path || (e.target_type || ':' || e.target_id)
            FROM reach r
            JOIN control_graph_edges e
              ON e.source_type = r.node_type
             AND e.source_id = r.node_id
             AND e.organization_id = %(org)s
             AND e.revoked_at IS NULL
             AND (e.valid_until IS NULL OR e.valid_until > now())
             AND (%(all_types)s OR e.edge_type = ANY(%(edge_types)s))
            WHERE r.depth < %(max_depth)s
              AND NOT ((e.target_type || ':' || e.target_id) = ANY(r.path))
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (node_type, node_id) node_type, node_id, depth, path
        FROM reach
        WHERE depth > 0
        ORDER BY node_type, node_id, depth
